blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Discrete diffusion models iteratively denoise a noisy sequence of categorical data such as text, enabling any-order generation with self-correction and in-filling capabilities. This makes them promising candidates for reasoning, planning, and constrained-generation tasks like coding and math. Yet masked and uniform diffusion erase a token's identity in a single corruption event, so their noisy states cannot explicitly represent partially resolved uncertainty in which several alternatives remain plausible. We close this gap with Binary Discrete Diffusion, a family of continuous-time discrete-diffusion processes whose noisy state is a set of candidate tokens per position, represented as a binary membership vector. Binary diffusion changes candidate sets through additions and removals, allowing information to be lost and recovered gradually while the diffusion state itself represents partial uncertainty. On Sudoku-Extreme, Boxoban, and graph coloring, the symmetric formulation of binary diffusion consistently outperforms strong, well-tuned masked and uniform baselines under matched architectures and controlled training, sampling, and tuning budgets, with its largest gains on the hardest instances, while remaining competitive on language modeling (Text8, TinyStories, OpenWebText). These results support candidate sets as an effective intermediate representation for iterative reasoning and show that the corruption kernel can materially change the computation learned by the reverse model.
blocks.zh: 散射模型迭代地将文本等杂乱的绝对数据序列排出,使任何具有自我修正和填充能力的顺序生成成为可能. 这使得他们在推理,规划,以及诸如编码和数学等受约束的生成任务上有希望的候选人. 然而,掩盖和统一的扩散抹去了一个标志在一次腐败事件中的身份,因此其吵闹的状态不能明确代表部分解决的不确定性,其中几种选择仍然可行。 我们用二进制散射法填补这一空白, 这是一个连续时间分散散射法的家族, 它的噪音状态是每个位置的一组候选符号, 作为二进制成员矢量。 二进制扩散变化可选办法通过添加和清除进行组合,使信息能够逐渐丢失和回收,而扩散状态本身代表了部分不确定性。 在Sudoku-Extreme, Boxoban, 和图色化上,二进制扩散的对称配方在匹配的架构和受控的训练,采样,和调整预算下,一贯超越强健,调和的面罩和统一基线,在最困难的情况下收益最大,同时在语言建模上保持竞争力(Text8, TinyStories, OpenWebText). 这些结果支持候选人设定为迭代推理的有效中间代表,并表明腐败内核可以实质性地改变反向模型所学到的计算.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Discrete diffusion models generate by iteratively refining a corrupted sequence.
Unlike autoregressive generation, decisions need not follow a fixed left-to-right order and can be revised later, while many positions can be updated in parallel ( Schiff et al., 2025 ; Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Gong et al., 2025 ) .
These properties make discrete diffusion attractive for reasoning, planning, and constrained generation ( Ye et al., 2025 ; Wewer et al., 2025 ) .
Yet sample quality at finite inference budgets remains challenging, motivating work on ordering, remasking, planned denoising, and search ( Kim et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Bai et al., 2026 ) .
We instead focus on a complementary axis: the corruption process itself.
How much can be gained by changing the corruption process, and in particular the intermediate representation on which denoising operates? Logic and planning are useful testbeds: they impose global constraints, admit exact solve-rate evaluation, and scale cleanly in difficulty at manageable computational cost, while sharing structure with coding, mathematics, and biological design ( Sahoo et al., 2026 ; Avdeyev et al., 2023 ; Stärk et al., 2024 ) .
They also expose a mismatch in the dominant masked and uniform kernels ( Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2024 ; Schiff et al., 2025 ; Sahoo et al., 2025 ) : a position cannot naturally express that several alternatives remain plausible.
A model solving Sudoku, for example, might narrow a cell from { 2 , 7 , 9 } \{2,7,9\} to { 7 , 9 } \{7,9\} , later reopen 2 2 as neighboring decisions are revised, and eventually settle on 7 7 .
blocks.zh:
通过迭代地精炼被腐蚀的序列来生成分明的传播模型.
与自发生成不同,决策不需要遵循固定的从左到右顺序,也可以在后期修改,而许多立场可以平行更新(Schiff等,2025;Sahoo等,2024;Gong等,2025.).
这些特性使得离散扩散对推理、规划和受限生成具有吸引力(Ye等人,2025年;Wewer等人,2025年)。
然而,有限推论预算的样本质量仍然具有挑战性,促使开展订购、装模作样、计划取名和搜索方面的工作(Kim等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年b;Liu等人,2025年;Bai等人,2026年)。
相反,我们侧重于一个互补轴心:腐败进程本身。
改变腐败过程,特别是取消提名的中间代表制,可以取得多大收益? 逻辑和规划是有用的试验床:它们施加全球制约,接受精确的解析率评价,并以可管理的计算成本在可操作的难度下保持平整的尺度,同时与编码、数学和生物设计共享结构(Sahoo等,2026;Avdeyev等,2023;Stärk等,2024)。
也暴露出占支配地位的遮盖和统一内核的不匹配(Sahoo等人,2024年;Shi等人,2024年;Schiff等人,2025年;Sahoo等人,2025年):一个立场自然不能表明几种替代品仍然合理。
例如,一个解决数独的模型可能会将一个单元格从 {2,7,9} {2,7,9} 缩入 {7,9}} {7,7,9} } 后来随着邻接决定的修改而重新打开 2 2, 并最终以 7 7 解决.

blocks.en:
We propose to make such candidate sets themselves the diffusion states.
A clean token is a singleton, while during reverse generation intermediate states can carry several live hypotheses that may be eliminated or restored.
More broadly, the corruption kernel does more than specify how examples are noised: it determines what information survives at intermediate times and how the model’s prediction is translated into reverse moves and their rates.
Identical architectures can therefore induce qualitatively different iterative computations under different kernels.
We instantiate this idea with Binary Discrete Diffusion , representing candidate sets by binary membership vectors in { 0 , 1 } V \{0,1\}^{V} (Figure 1 ).
In binary symmetric diffusion , membership bits can switch both on and off, allowing hypotheses to be eliminated and later restored.
In binary absorbing diffusion , corruption only adds candidates, so reverse generation progressively prunes the set toward a singleton.
blocks.zh:
我们建议让这种候选人成为传播状态。
一个干净的代号是单子,而反相生成中间状态中可以携带几种活的假说,这些假说可能会被消除或还原.
更广义地说,腐败内核所做的不仅仅是说明如何点出例子:它决定了哪些信息在中间时间存活下来,以及模型的预测如何被转化为倒移及其速率.
因此,同质结构可以在不同的内核下诱导质地不同的迭代计算.
我们用二进制 Discrete diffusion 来即兴分析这个想法, 代表二进制成员矢量在 {0, 1} V } {0, 1}V (图 1 ) 中的候选组合。
在二进制对称传播中,会籍比特可以同时开关和关闭,从而可以消除并随后恢复假说.

blocks.en:
Although each position has a nominal state space of size 2 V 2^{V} , every state has only V V single-bit neighbors, and all neighboring reverse rates can be computed in O ⁡ ( V ) O(V) time from the model’s usual V V -way prediction, without enumerating subsets.
The model learns these dynamics from clean solutions without candidate labels, task-specific deduction rules, or symbolic search.
The richer state also enables candidate-aware sampling : we derive exact ancestral updates through a shared clean-token proposal, adapt re-corrupt sampling, and, building on Ψ \Psi -sampling and confidence-guided remasking ( Deschenaux et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) , develop revision rules that choose both which positions to reconsider and which hypotheses to reopen.

该模型从没有候选标签的清洁解决方案,任务特定扣除规则,或符号搜索中学习出这些动态.
比较富裕的状态也使得候选人的抽样成为可能:我们通过共同的清洁抽样建议获得准确的祖传更新,调整再腐烂的抽样,并在 \ Psi -- -- 抽样和信心指导再造的基础上(Deschenaux等,2026;Wang等,2025b),制定修订规则,选择哪些立场需要重新考虑,哪些假设需要重开。

blocks.en:
We evaluate Binary Discrete Diffusion on Sudoku-Extreme ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , Boxoban ( Guez et al., 2018 ) , and graph coloring under controlled architectures, training budgets, and sampler tuning, using direct single-attempt solutions without verifier-guided selection.
Across all three tasks, a consistent pattern emerges: binary symmetric diffusion outperforms uniform diffusion, and both outperform masked and binary absorbing diffusion .
The advantage of binary symmetric over uniform grows on harder regimes, including low-clue Sudoku, long-horizon Boxoban, and graph coloring far beyond the training size.
On Text8, TinyStories, and OpenWebText ( Mahoney, 2011 ; Eldan & Li, 2023 ; Gokaslan & Cohen, 2019 ) , binary diffusion remains competitive with established kernels.
These results support candidate sets as an effective intermediate representation for iterative reasoning and show that the corruption process can materially change the computation learned by the reverse model.

在所有这三项任务中,都出现了一个一致的模式: 二进制对称扩散超越了统一扩散,同时超越了掩体和二进制吸收扩散。

3 Binary discrete diffusion
blocks.zh: 3个 二进制离散扩散

blocks.en:
In binary diffusion, the noisy state at each position is a set of candidate tokens .
We represent a clean token c ∈ [ V ] c\in[V] by the singleton { c } \{c\} , and corruption changes this set by adding or removing candidates, so that an intermediate state can retain several alternatives at a single position.
Representing each set by its binary membership vector identifies the noisy state Z t i Z_{t}^{i} with a vertex of the binary cube { 0 , 1 } V \{0,1\}^{V} , and we use the same symbol for a noisy set z z and its membership vector, including for a clean singleton { c } \{c\} and its one-hot vector.
We consider two corruption processes on this space: binary symmetric diffusion , under which candidates can be both removed and restored, and binary absorbing diffusion , which only adds candidates.
We focus primarily on the symmetric process and treat the absorbing process as a simpler monotone counterpart.

In binary diffusion, the first false candidate doubles the number of candidates for the clean token, whereas each later one enlarges an already large set.

Following ReMDM-conf, we use the model’s confidence in its clean proposal Z ~ 0 i \mathchoice{\widetilde{Z}_{0}^{i}}{\smash[t]{\widetilde{Z}_{0}^{i}}\vphantom{Z_{0}^{i}}}{\widetilde{Z}_{0}^{i}}{\widetilde{Z}_{0}^{i}}{} , read from the cavity or the denoiser, to concentrate revision on uncertain positions.

blocks.en:
We compare the four kernels using unconditional generation on three corpora of increasing sequence length L L : Text8 ( Mahoney, 2011 ) at L = 256 L=256 , TinyStories ( Eldan & Li, 2023 ) at L = 512 L=512 , and OpenWebText ( Gokaslan & Cohen, 2019 ) at L = 1024 L=1024 (App. F.6 ).
We train every model on 131B tokens, on Text8 at the character level with V = 27 V=27 and on TinyStories and OpenWebText with byte-pair-encoding tokenizers of V = 1024 V=1024 , using as training objective the path term of the negative ELBO ( 3 ) (except for masked and binary absorbing diffusion on Text8, see App. C.2 ).

blocks.en: 6 Related work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en:
Discrete diffusion was first formulated on a discrete time grid, modeling the reverse transitions directly ( Hoogeboom et al., 2021 ; Austin et al., 2021 ) , and its continuous-time formulation instead learns to reverse a categorical jump process ( Campbell et al., 2022 ; Sun et al., 2023 ) .
Since then, methods have differed mainly in how they parameterize the reverse rates ( Lou et al., 2024 ; Ou et al., 2025 ) and in which paths the forward process allows ( von Rütte et al., 2025 ; Shaul et al., 2025 ) .
Closer to our setting, simplex-valued methods represent categorical uncertainty in a continuous state ( Floto et al., 2023 ; Avdeyev et al., 2023 ) , while partial and semantic masking keep residual information about the clean token ( Chao et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) .
Binary diffusion instead changes the state space: each position follows a jump process on the binary cube, whose coordinates express candidate membership.
Similar bit-flipping processes have been explored to model binary data, where the cube is the data space ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ; Pham et al., 2025 ) .
The closest predecessor is the ShortListing Model, which also grows candidate sets, in discrete time ( Song et al., 2025 ) .
Under the right noise schedule, its corruption process provides a discrete-time formulation of binary absorbing diffusion (App. E ).
Our main contributions are the non-absorbing symmetric process, which allows candidates to be both removed and restored during denoising, and the empirical evaluation on logic and planning tasks.

分解扩散最早是在离散时间网格上被分解出,直接模拟逆向过渡(Hoogeboom等,2021年;Austin等,2021年),其连续时间的配方反而学会了逆向直跳过程(Campbell等,2022年;Sun等,2023年).
从那时起,方法主要在如何将反向率参数化(Lou等人,2024年;Ou等人,2025年)和前进过程允许的路径(von Rütte等人,2025年;Shaul等人,2025年)方面有所不同。

我们的主要贡献是非吸收的对称过程,这使得候选人在解密期间既被除名又被恢复,以及对逻辑和规划任务的经验性评价.

blocks.en:
Discrete diffusion has been applied to Sudoku and other structured problems before ( Ye et al., 2025 ; Wewer et al., 2025 ) , and follow-up work improves solving through adaptive token order, remasking, explicit planning, or test-time search ( Kim et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
Sudoku is also a standard benchmark for small recurrent reasoners such as HRM and TRM ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Jolicoeur-Martineau, 2025 ) , and Lattice Deduction Transformers likewise maintain per-variable candidate sets but train deduction on-policy with search and abstention heuristics ( Davis et al., 2026 ) .
All of these change the sampler, the architecture, or the training signal.
Our experiments are instead designed to isolate the effect of the corruption kernel and evaluate direct, verifier-free samples from each kernel’s tuned sampler.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We have introduced Binary Discrete Diffusion, a family of continuous-time discrete-diffusion processes whose noisy states are sets of candidate tokens, represented as binary membership vectors.
Parameterizing the reverse process through clean-token predictions lets a single V V -way output determine all reverse rates and sampling updates, avoiding any 2 V 2^{V} enumeration in training and generation.
We also introduced a confidence-guided self-correcting sampler that chooses which positions and candidates to reopen.
Under controlled architectures, training budgets, and sampler tuning, binary symmetric diffusion outperforms uniform diffusion, and both outperform masked and binary absorbing diffusion on logic and planning tasks, with the largest gains on the hardest instances.
Binary diffusion also remains competitive on language modeling.
Our results thus show that candidate sets can be an effective intermediate representation for iterative reasoning, and that the corruption process can materially change the computation learned by the model.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了二进制散射(Binary Discrete Difusion),这是一个由连续时间分离散分出过程组成的家族,其吵闹的状态是一组候选符号,代表二进制会籍向量.
通过干净的调试预测来参数化倒转过程,让单一的V V - way输出来决定所有倒转率和采样更新,避免任何2 V 2^{V}在培训和生成中进行计数.
我们还引入了一个有信心指导的自我纠正抽样人员,选择重新开放哪些职位和候选人。
在受控架构,培训预算,和采样器调制下,二进制对称传播超越了统一传播,同时在逻辑和规划任务上都超越了变相和二进制吸收传播,在最难的情况下收获最大.
二进制传播在语言建模方面也仍然具有竞争力.
因此,我们的结果显示,候选人组合可以成为迭代推理的有效中间代表,腐败过程可以实质性地改变模型所学到的计算。

blocks.en:
Binary diffusion also opens a broader design space for candidate-set and bitwise corruption processes.
Future kernels could exploit semantic or task-specific structure to introduce plausible candidates rather than random ones.
The bits could also encode tokens differently, for example through their binary indices or an error-correcting code, although each such code defines a different state space whose states are no longer candidate sets.
Richer representations of candidate sets than the normalized embedding sum used here may also prove useful at larger scales.
Scaling these ideas to larger models and datasets, and to domains such as code, mathematics, and biological sequence design, is a natural next step.
blocks.zh:
二进制传播还为候选人设置和位取腐败过程开辟了更广泛的设计空间.
未来的内核可以利用语义结构或特定任务结构来引进可能的候选人,而不是随机的候选人。
比特也可以用不同的方式编码符号,例如通过它们的二进制索引或错误校正代码,尽管每个这样的代码都定义了一个不同的状态空间,其状态不再是候选的集.
与此处所用的正常嵌入总额相比,候选人组合的表述更为丰富,在更大的尺度上也可能证明是有用的。
将这些想法推广到更大的模型和数据集,以及代码,数学,生物序列设计等领域,是自然的下一步.

blocks.en: AI use statement
blocks.zh: AI 语句

blocks.en:
Large language models were used to aid and polish writing (editing and reviewing the manuscript), for retrieval and discovery (finding and summarizing related work), and for research ideation and execution (implementing, running, and analyzing experiments).
All AI-assisted work was reviewed by the authors, who verified every technical claim and result and take full responsibility for the final content.

所有AI协助的工作都经过了提交人的审查,他们核实了每一项技术要求和结果,并对最后内容承担了全部责任。

For uniform and binary symmetric diffusion, the terminal-prior term is finite and available analytically (Apps. A.2 and B.1 ).
With the prior matched to the limiting forward distribution, the boundary contributions vanish as t 1 ↓ 0 t_{1}\downarrow 0 and t 2 ↑ 1 t_{2}\uparrow 1 , recovering ( 3 ).
For masked and binary absorbing diffusion, the limiting prior is a point mass, so the terminal KL is infinite for every t 2 < 1 t_{2}<1 but zero at t 2 = 1 t_{2}=1 .
The terminal endpoint therefore requires separate treatment, and App. F.3 describes our likelihood-evaluation convention.

The path ELBO was best everywhere except on Text8, where we train masked diffusion on xent, which coincides with its flat ELBO, and binary absorbing diffusion on wxent.

blocks.en:
The base schedule reparameterizes corruption time on the clipped window [ t 1 , t 2 ] [t_{1},t_{2}] by ξ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \xi\in[0,1] , which we draw uniformly during training.
The linear, logarithmic, and cosine maps are t lin ​ ( ξ ) = t 1 + ( t 2 − t 1 ) ​ ξ , t log ​ ( ξ ) = t 1 ​ ( t 2 t 1 ) ξ , t cos ​ ( ξ ) = t 1 + ( t 2 − t 1 ) ​ sin 2 ⁡ ( π ​ ξ 2 ) , t_{\mathrm{lin}}(\xi)=t_{1}+(t_{2}-t_{1})\xi,\qquad t_{\log}(\xi)=t_{1}\left(\frac{t_{2}}{t_{1}}\right)^{\xi},\qquad t_{\cos}(\xi)=t_{1}+(t_{2}-t_{1})\sin^{2}\!\Big(\frac{\pi\xi}{2}\Big), (55) which give the base sampling densities on [ t 1 , t 2 ] [t_{1},t_{2}] p lin ​ ( t ) = 1 t 2 − t 1 , p log ​ ( t ) = 1 t ​ log ⁡ ( t 2 / t 1 ) , p cos ​ ( t ) = 1 π ​ ( t − t 1 ) ​ ( t 2 − t ) . p_{\mathrm{lin}}(t)=\frac{1}{t_{2}-t_{1}},\qquad p_{\log}(t)=\frac{1}{t\log(t_{2}/t_{1})},\qquad p_{\cos}(t)=\frac{1}{\pi\sqrt{(t-t_{1})(t_{2}-t)}}. (56) Logarithmic sampling assigns equal probability to intervals with the same ratio of endpoints, giving more resolution near clean data.
At large vocabularies, this matches how the binary kernels lose information (App. C.4 ).
Cosine sampling instead gives more resolution near both ends of the window.
To estimate the path integral without bias, we weight each sequence’s loss by the inverse density of its sampled time, namely t 2 − t 1 t_{2}-t_{1} for the linear schedule, t ​ log ⁡ ( t 2 / t 1 ) t\log(t_{2}/t_{1}) for the logarithmic schedule, and π ​ ( t − t 1 ) ​ ( t 2 − t ) \pi\sqrt{(t-t_{1})(t_{2}-t)} for the cosine schedule.

We give ξ \xi to the network as its time input: ξ ⁡ ( t ) = { t − t 1 t 2 − t 1 , linear schedule , log ⁡ ( t / t 1 ) log ⁡ ( t 2 / t 1 ) , logarithmic schedule , 2 π ​ arcsin ⁡ t − t 1 t 2 − t 1 , cosine schedule . \xi(t)=\begin{cases}\displaystyle\frac{t-t_{1}}{t_{2}-t_{1}},&\text{linear schedule},\\[6.0pt]
\displaystyle\frac{\log(t/t_{1})}{\log(t_{2}/t_{1})},&\text{logarithmic schedule},\\[6.0pt]
\displaystyle\frac{2}{\pi}\arcsin\sqrt{\frac{t-t_{1}}{t_{2}-t_{1}}},&\text{cosine schedule}.\end{cases} (57) The adaptive proposal below also acts on ξ \xi , while the kernel and rates retain their definitions in corruption time t t .
We choose inference grids separately from training-time sampling.
Applying any map in ( 55 ) to j / N j/N , for j = 0 , … , N j=0,\ldots,N , gives a linear, logarithmic, or cosine grid for N N reverse steps, traversed in decreasing j j as in Algorithm 1 .
The logarithmic grid has smaller absolute steps near t 1 t_{1} , and the cosine grid near both ends of the window.
We train with the linear and logarithmic schedules (Tables 3 and 4 ) and sample on grids of all three kinds (Table 7 ).

C.5 Adaptive gradient-RMS importance sampling

blocks.en:
Adaptive importance sampling replaces the base schedule by a proposal that draws more samples where loss gradients are large.
It improved over the base schedule alone in all our experiments, so we train every model, for all four kernels and all tasks, with it.
The statistic is the root-mean-square norm of the gradient with respect to the network’s output logits, used as an inexpensive proxy for parameter-gradient norms.

blocks.en: Appendix E Extended related work
blocks.zh: 附 录 E

blocks.en:
Several lines of work broaden the forward path without introducing candidate sets.
Generalized interpolating diffusion and kinetic path design admit richer categorical couplings ( von Rütte et al., 2025 ; Shaul et al., 2025 ) , partial masking inserts intermediate corruption states between a token and a full mask ( Chao et al., 2025 ) , and sticky jump processes combine discrete jumps with continuous coordinates ( Jutras-Dubé et al., 2026 ) .
CADD and CANDI go further and augment or hybridize the categorical state with a continuous one ( Zheng et al., 2025a ; Pynadath et al., 2025 ) .
Even at scale, and with architectures and training budgets matched, the choice between masking, uniform corruption, and interpolating paths remains consequential ( Sahoo et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
有几个工作方向扩大了前进道路,但没有引入候选人组合。
一般的内插扩散和动能路径设计允许更丰富的绝对结合(von Rütte等人,第2段)。 ; 2025; Shaul等, 2025), 部分遮掩将中间腐败状态插入到一个令牌和一个全遮掩之间(Chao等, 2025),并粘性跳跃过程将离散跳跃与连续坐标相结合(Jutras-Dubé等, 2026).
CADD和CANDI更进一步,用连续状态增强或混合绝对状态(Zheng等人,2025年a;Pyndath等人,2025年)。
即使在规模上,而且在结构和培训预算相匹配的情况下,隐蔽、统一的腐败和插图路径之间的选择仍然必然(Sahoo等人,2026年)。

blocks.en:
There is also a substantial simplex-valued lineage, which lifts categories to continuous points on the simplex or updates distribution parameters directly ( Richemond et al., 2022 ; Floto et al., 2023 ; Avdeyev et al., 2023 ; Stärk et al., 2024 ; Graves et al., 2023 ; Chandra et al., 2026 ) .
Simplax is the closest of these to our setting: it keeps uniform categorical diffusion as its marginal and adds an exact Dirichlet auxiliary variable to the reverse bridge ( Sakurai et al., 2026 ) .
Its denoiser, however, still observes a corrupted category, whereas binary diffusion exposes the candidate set to the denoiser as the noisy state.
blocks.zh:
还有一个相当的简单x值分系,将分类提升到简单x或更新分配参数上的连续点(Richemond等,2022;Floto等,2023;Avdeyev等,2023;Stärk等,2024;Graves等,2023;Chandra等,2026).
Simplax最接近于我们的设定:它保持统一的绝对扩散作为其边缘,并在倒桥上添加一个精确的Dirichlet辅助变量(Sakurai等,2026年).
然而,它的阴茎仍然观察到一个腐败的类别,而二进制传播则将被设定为阴茎的候选人暴露为阴茎的阴茎。

blocks.en:
Prior binary diffusion methods treat each bit as part of the object being generated.
Bit-flip diffusion of binary data goes back to binomial diffusion ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ) , and DMPM studies its continuous-time form ( Pham et al., 2025 ) .
BerDiff applies a Bernoulli kernel to binary segmentation masks ( Chen et al., 2023a ) , GraphGUIDE adds, removes, or flips graph edges through Bernoulli transitions ( Tseng et al., 2023 ) , and Blackout diffusion models discrete counts through birth–death processes ( Santos et al., 2023 ) .
Analog Bits instead encodes one category in ⌈ log 2 ⁡ V ⌉ \lceil\log_{2}V\rceil real-valued bit coordinates and applies continuous diffusion ( Chen et al., 2023b ) .
In binary diffusion, by contrast, there are V V binary coordinates per position and an active bit denotes membership in the noisy subset.
blocks.zh:
先前的二进制扩散方法将每个位作为生成对象的一部分处理.
Bit-flip 二进制数据的传播可追溯到二进制传播(Sohl-Dickstein等,2015年),DMPM研究其持续时间形式(Pham等,2025年).
BerDiff将伯努利内核应用于二元分解口罩(Chen等,2023年a),GraphGUIDE通过伯努利过渡(Tseng等,2023年)添加,去除或翻转图边,以及Blackout传播模型通过出生-死亡过程离散计数(Santos等,2023年).
Analog Bits转而将一个类别编码在 QQ log 2 V \lceil\log 2}V\rceil 实值比特坐标并应用连续扩散(Chen等, 2023b).
在二进制扩散中,相形之下,每个位置都有V V 二进制坐标,一个活性位点表示在噪音子集中的会籍.

blocks.en:
The ShortListing Model (SLM) is the closest predecessor ( Song et al., 2025 ) .
It represents a categorical variable by a nonempty candidate set, starts the forward process from the clean singleton, activates false candidates until reaching the full vocabulary, and samples in reverse by progressive candidate pruning.
However, the model is formulated in discrete time and identifies sets with simplex-face centroids.
To see the correspondence with binary absorbing diffusion, let n t n_{t} be SLM’s expected candidate-set size at time t t and take the linear noise schedule n t = 1 + ( V − 1 ) ​ t . n_{t}=1+(V-1)t. (68) The probability of adding a candidate between times s < t s<t is then n t − n s V − n s = t − s 1 − s , \frac{n_{t}-n_{s}}{V-n_{s}}=\frac{t-s}{1-s}, (69) and the clean-conditioned probability of retaining a false candidate is n s − 1 n t − 1 = s t , \frac{n_{s}-1}{n_{t}-1}=\frac{s}{t}, (70) which are the absorbing kernel ( 41 ) and bridge ( 49 ).
blocks.zh:
ShortListing Model (SLM)是最接近的前身(宋等,2025.).
它代表了由非空候选人设定的绝对变量,从干净的单子开始前进过程,激活假候选人直到达到完整的词汇,通过渐进候选人的挤压来取回样本.
然而,该模型是在离散的时间内拟订的,并用简单的x-面相中间体识别出各套.

blocks.en:
Beyond Autoregression established masked diffusion baselines on Sudoku and other reasoning and planning tasks ( Ye et al., 2025 ) .
Dirichlet diffusion solves Sudoku in a continuous simplex state ( Avdeyev et al., 2023 ) , and Simplax reports Sudoku generalization across clue densities ( Sakurai et al., 2026 ) .
Several analyses show that the corruption and the order of updates matter as much as the model: Spatial Reasoning Models find that the order of variable updates strongly affects accuracy ( Wewer et al., 2025 ) , and the locality induced by the corruption and factorization changes trainability on Sudoku and graph path-finding ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
On the theoretical side, masked diffusion models can simulate chain-of-thought under finite precision ( Svete & Sabharwal, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
除了自动退缩之外,还确定了关于数独和其他推理和规划任务的隐蔽扩散基线(Ye等人,2025年)。
Dirichlet扩散在连续的简单x状态下解决了sudoku(Avdeyev等,2023年),而Simplax则报道了sudoku泛化跨越了线索密度(Sakurai等,2026年).
一些分析表明,腐败和更新顺序与模型同样重要: 空间理性模型发现,可变更新的顺序会强烈地影响准确性(Wewer等,2025年),而由腐败和因素化所引发的地点会改变在数多库和图表路径查找上的可受性(Wang等,2026年).
在理论方面,蒙面扩散模型可以在有限精度下模拟思维链(Svete & Sabharwal,2026.).

blocks.en:
A separate line of work changes the reverse-time policy rather than the forward state, through token ordering, planned denoising and path planning, remasking, learned reveal schedules, or search during and around sampling ( Kim et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Peng et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Ta et al., 2026 ; Bai et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
These methods compose with any corruption kernel, and beyond the confidence-guided re-corruption of Section 4 we use none of them: our verifier-free solve rate refers to direct samples from each kernel’s tuned sampler, without search, reranking, or a symbolic solver.
blocks.zh:
单独的一行工作改变倒置时间政策,而不是前置状态,通过象征性的订购,有计划的去名和路径规划,再现,学习的揭示时间表,或在采样期间和周围进行搜索(Kim等,2025;Liu等,2025;Peng等,2025;Wang等,2025b;Kim等,2026;Xu等,2026;Ta等,2026;Bai等,2026;Zhang等,2026)。
这些方法由任何腐败内核组成,除了第4节的自信指引再腐败之外,我们没有使用任何方法:我们的无核查者解析率是指每个内核调制样品的直接样本,没有搜索、重新排位或象征性的解析器。

blocks.en:
Sudoku and related benchmarks have also driven a rapidly growing literature on small recurrent reasoners, which allocate computation through repeated latent updates, fixed-point dynamics, or looped layers ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Jolicoeur-Martineau, 2025 ; Sghaier et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Fein-Ashley & Rashidinejad, 2026 ; Helbling et al., 2026 ; Cameron et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) .
These approaches change the architecture, the training dynamics, or the recurrent depth, which is a separate axis from the corruption state that binary diffusion changes, so we do not compare against them directly.
blocks.zh:
数分和相关的基准也催生出关于小的反复出现的原因论的文献迅速增长,它们通过反复潜在更新、固定点动态或循环层来分配计算(Wang等人,2025a;Jolicoeur-Martineau,2025;Sghaier等人,2026;Huang等人,2026;Fein-Ashley & Rashidinejad,2026;Helbling等人,2026;Cameron等人,2026;Lee等人,2026)。
这些方法改变了结构,培训动态,或者重复的深度,这是与腐败分开的轴线,表明二进制传播改变,所以我们不直接比较.

blocks.en: F.2 Learning-rate and checkpoint selection
blocks.zh: F.2 学习率和检查站选择

blocks.en:
We selected the learning rate of each task and kernel from { 10 − 4 , 3 ⋅ 10 − 4 , 10 − 3 } \{10^{-4},3\cdot 10^{-4},10^{-3}\} on the validation NELBO of App. F.3 , computed on 51,200 validation draws and averaged over two training seeds (Table 5 ).
Within each task, kernel, and seed, all learning rates share the data, times, and corruptions, so their differences have a Monte Carlo standard error below 3 ⋅ 10 − 4 3\cdot 10^{-4} , and the variation between seeds dominates.
We tune Sudoku and graph coloring at their full training budget and Boxoban at 1M steps.
On Boxoban uniform and binary absorbing, the two lowest learning rates are within seed noise, and in both cases we keep the middle rate 3 ⋅ 10 − 4 3\cdot 10^{-4} .
Since Boxoban validation NELBO was still improving slowly at that point, we trained the selected rates for 2.5M steps and selected a checkpoint for each run on the validation NELBO, evaluated every 100k steps from 1M.
We keep the final checkpoint unless an earlier one is lower by more than two standard errors of the paired difference, and only two binary absorbing seeds select an earlier checkpoint, at 2.0M and 1.0M steps.

在每个任务,内核,和种子中,所有学习率都分享数据,时间,和腐败,因此他们的差异在3~10~4 3\cdot 10~4}以下有一个蒙特卡洛标准错误,种子之间的差异占主导地位.
我们用全部的训练预算来调取数独和图色,用一米步来调取Boxoban。
在Boxoban统一和二进制吸收上,两种最低的学习率都在种子噪声之内,在这两种情况下,我们保留了中速率 3 ~ 10 − 4 3\cdot 10^{-4}。
Boxoban 验证以来 NELBO当时仍在缓慢改善,我们培训了2.5M级的选定收费标准,并在NELBO验证上为每次运行选择了一个检查点,从1M级的每100k级进行评分.
我们保留最后的检查站,除非较早的检查站低于对等差的两个标准差数,只有两个二进制吸收种子选择较早的检查站,为2.0M和1.0M级.

blocks.en: F.3 Evaluation
blocks.zh: F.3 评价

blocks.en:
We evaluate the finite-window NELBO ( 50 ) on the training window with the estimators used in training.
For the path term, we draw one time per sequence from the training time schedule with inverse-density weighting.
We estimate reconstruction from forward corruptions at t 1 t_{1} with the denoiser as decoder, and visible tokens in masked diffusion are copied exactly and have zero reconstruction loss.
The prior is the limiting distribution from which generation starts.
Its KL from the time- t 2 t_{2} corruption is analytic for uniform and binary symmetric diffusion (Apps. A.2 and B.1 ).
For masked and binary absorbing diffusion the prior is a point mass, so that the KL is infinite for t 2 < 1 t_{2}<1 and zero at t 2 = 1 t_{2}=1 , and we omit it.
We aggregate the total NELBO over scored tokens, excluding padding and conditioning clues.

We score logic models on direct samples, with one attempt per instance and no verifier or selection among attempts, so the reported solve rate is single-attempt success.
Sudoku success requires the completed reference grid, and Boxoban success requires legal actions that end with every box on a goal, with the action sequence read up to the first STAY , the no-operation action that pads solutions.
Graph coloring accepts any proper coloring.
We evaluate the selected EMA checkpoint of each of the five training seeds (App. F.2 ) with a linear sampling grid on [ 0.01 , 0.9999 ] [0.01,0.9999] and the sampler selected on validation at the reference NFE, 256 for Sudoku and Boxoban and 64 for graph coloring (App. F.4 ).
The tables use the full test splits, and the NFE and training curves use 8,192 and 4,096 test instances, except in their hard columns, which use every hard test instance.
We evaluate every kernel on the same instances and fix the difficulty bins on validation data.
The hard subsets are defined with the data in App. F.5 .
We report the mean and standard error over training seeds.
blocks.zh:
我们在直接样本上得分逻辑模型,每例一次尝试,在尝试中不进行验证或选择,所以所报告的解答率是单试成功.
数独的成功需要完成的参考网格,而Boxoban的成功需要法律行动,以每个框在一个目标上结束,动作序列读取到第一个STAY,即支撑解决方案的不操作行动.
图形颜色接受任何适当的颜色。
我们评价五个训练种子中每个种子(App.F.2)选定的EMA检查站,在[0.01, 0.9999][0.01, 0.9999]上有一个线性取样网,并在NFE参考文献中鉴定选定的取样器,其中256个用于南斗和Boxoban,64个用于图色(App.F.4)。
表格采用全试分出法,而NFE和训练曲线采用8,192和4,096个试验例,但硬列除外,硬列使用每个硬试验例.
我们在同一实例上评估每个内核,并修正验证数据上的难度。
硬子集以App.F.5中的数据来定义.
我们报告在训练种子上的错误,

blocks.en:
We tune every sampler setting on the validation split and evaluate on the test split of each corpus (App. F.6 ).
After removing special tokens, we retokenize complete decoded strings with GPT-2 Large for GenPPL and MAUVE features.
Each sample set holds 2,000 samples from one generation seed, and each reported value averages the two generation seeds of a sampler setting.
Entropy is the unigram entropy, in nats, of the GPT-2 tokens pooled over a sample set rather than a within-string average, so it measures the diversity of the set as a whole.
GenPPL is the exponential of the total GPT-2 Large negative log-likelihood of the sample set divided by its total token count, so it is pooled over tokens rather than averaged over strings.
We compute MAUVE with 200 buckets and average it over four reference draws and five clustering seeds, with reference subsets sampled without replacement and of the size of the generated sample set.
Error bars span the two generation seeds and condition on the checkpoint.
blocks.zh:
我们调制每个取样器在验证时的设置,并评估每个实体的测试分法(App.F.6.)。
在去除特殊符后,我们用GPT-2 Large重新整理出完整的解码字符串,用于GenPPL和MAUVE特性.
每套样本中,有2 000个来自一代种子的样本,每套样本上报的平均值是采样者设定的两代种子。
Entropy是GPT-2令牌在一组样本上集合而成的unigram entropy,用nats表示,而不是一个内弦平均值,所以它测量了整个集的多样性.
GENPPL是样本集的总GPT-2大负对数的指数,除以其总的符号数,所以它是集合于符号上而不是平均于字符串上.
我们用200桶来计算MAUVE,平均超过4个参考图纸和5个集群种子,参考子集的样本没有替换,并符合生成的样本集的大小。
错误栏横跨检查站的两代种子和条件。

blocks.en: F.4 Sampler tuning procedure
blocks.zh: F.4 样品调制程序

blocks.en:
We sample every kernel with the confidence-guided Ψ \Psi -sampler of App. D .
Its settings are the temperature T T , the re-corrupt fraction η \eta , the confidence coordinate, the position-confidence strength γ \gamma , the ordering tilt λ \lambda , and the candidate-confidence strength β \beta , which we tune for every kernel but masked diffusion on the logic tasks and for the binary kernels on text.
On text, we also tune the nucleus top- p p and the spacing of the sampling grid.
We apply temperature and top- p p to the denoiser rather than to the cavity ( Casado Noguerales et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们用App.D的扫描器来取样每个内核
它的设置是温度 T T,再腐蚀分数 *\eta, 信心坐标, 位置自信强度 QQ\gamma, 命令倾斜 QQ\ lambda, 以及候选自信强度 β\ beta, 我们调制每个内核, 但是在逻辑任务和文本上的二进制内核 。
在文字上,我们也调取核上-p和取样网格的间隔.
我们把温度和上-p应用到阴道上,而不是阴道上(Casado Noguerales等,2026年)。

blocks.en:
For each task and kernel, we select these settings on validation over the grids of Table 7 .
On the logic tasks the score is the mean solve rate over the training seeds on a fixed validation split of 2,048 instances (1,024 for the large graphs) at the reference NFE.
On text it is MAUVE at NFE = L =L , screened with 512 samples and confirmed with 2,000 samples for the three best candidates.
We then freeze the selection for every test measurement, budget, and training seed unless otherwise stated.
We select the sampler of the hard columns separately on the hard subsets of the validation splits.
The grids are not full products: the ordering and confidence strengths enter through a few sub-grids, and we give masked diffusion, which has no candidate to reopen, a matching number of extra ordering and re-corruption points in place of the candidate-confidence settings (Table 7 ), so we tune every kernel with the same budget.
Because the cavity and the denoiser coincide for masked diffusion, the confidence coordinate has no effect there.
Table 10 selects over nested subsets of the logic grid: ancestral sampling, re-corruption alone, the Ψ \Psi -sampler without confidence, with position confidence, and with every setting, so each row reports what its settings add.
Candidate confidence lifts binary symmetric diffusion on Sudoku and binary absorbing diffusion on the large graphs, whereas it is only selected for uniform diffusion on the Boxoban hard subset.
Tables 8 and 9 list the selected settings.
blocks.zh:
对于每个任务和内核,我们从表 7 的网格上通过验证选择这些设置 。
在逻辑任务上,分数是参考NFE上2,048个实例(大图为1,024个)的固定验证分数上对训练种子的平均解析率.

除非另有说明,否则我们将冻结每次测试、预算和培训种子的选择。

网格不是完整的产品:订购和信心的优势通过几个子网格进入,我们给出了遮掩的传播,它没有重新开放的候选资格,一个匹配的附加订购和再腐败点取代候选自信设置(表7),所以我们用同样的预算来调和每一个内核.

blocks.en: F.5 Logic tasks
blocks.zh: F.5 逻辑任务

blocks.en: In every task, we condition the model on the given part of the instance: we show it clean, never corrupt it, and exclude it from the loss, so all randomness and revision act on the generated positions.
blocks.zh: 在每一个任务中,我们把模型以特定的例子部分作为条件:我们显示它干净,从不腐化它,并且排除它从损失中,所以所有随机性和在生成的位置上修正行为.

blocks.en:
For Sudoku, we use the Sudoku-Extreme boards of Wang et al. (2025a) , 3.8M training boards and a test pool of 423k, as 81 digit tokens with the clue cells fixed.
We mark the clue cells with an embedding added to the input.
This changed little for the masked and binary kernels but was necessary for uniform diffusion to train at all, since a clue is otherwise indistinguishable from a uniformly corrupted cell.
We partition the test pool into validation and test sets of about 200k and 223k boards that are orbit-disjoint under the augmentation symmetries (digit relabeling, board flips, and rotations), and the hard subset of the test set keeps the boards with at most 22 clues (4.1%).
blocks.zh:
对数多库来说,我们使用王等(2025a)的数多库-外相板,3.8M的训练板和423k的测试池,作为81位数的代号,并固定了线索细胞.
我们用输入中加入的嵌入来标记线索细胞.
这对蒙面和二进制内核来说变化不大,但对于统一扩散来训练来说却十分必要,因为一条线索在其他方面与统一的腐败细胞是分不开的。
我们把测试池分割成验证和测试组,由大约200k和223k个板组成,这些板在增强对称性下是轨道相分离的(数字重贴标签,板翻和旋转),测试组的硬子集最多保存有22个线索(4.1%).

blocks.en:
For Boxoban, we use the 10 × 10 10\times 10 levels of Guez et al. (2018) with the A ⋆ solutions of Garriga-Alonso et al. (2024) and keep the levels whose solution replays to a solved board.
Each sequence is the flattened board followed by 128 action tokens, the solution padded with STAY , and we score the whole action region.
Because the official test pool holds only 1,000 levels, we partition the 92k solved levels of the official validation pool once into validation and test sets of 25k levels each and fold the remaining 42k into the 936k training levels, and the hard subset keeps the boards whose solution needs at least 40 moves (19.8%).
blocks.zh:
对Boxoban来说,我们使用Guez等人的10×10 10\times 10级(2018年)与Garriga-Alonso等人的A-Q溶液(2024年),并保留其溶液回放到已解板的级别.
每一个序列都是平板,然后是128个动作符号, 溶液加进STAY, 我们得分整个动作区域。
由于官方测试池只有1000个级别,我们把92k解析出的官方验证池一度分入验证和测试组,每组为25k级,并将所剩的42k折叠为936k级训练,硬子集保留了其解决方案至少需要40个动作的板(19.8%).

blocks.en:
Graph coloring instances are random graphs with a planted four-coloring: 64 vertices in four balanced color classes, with each cross-class edge present independently with probability 0.2 0.2 , so the mean degree is 9.6 9.6 , just above the Kesten–Stigum threshold ( k − 1 ) 2 = 9 (k-1)^{2}=9 for k = 4 k=4 colors, below which the planted coloring is undetectable.
Any proper coloring counts as a solution, not only the planted one.
We pass the graph’s adjacency matrix to the model as an attention mask and generate instances on the fly from separate seeded streams for training, validation (2,048 instances), and test (100k).
The hard subset consists of 4,096 graphs of 640 vertices at the same mean degree, with the edge probability scaled to 0.02 0.02 .
blocks.zh:
相图取色例为随机图,并有被植入的四色相图:64个顶点为4个相平衡相色相,每个相相相相相的边缘独立地呈现出概率为0.2:0.2,因此平均度为9.6:9.6,正上方为克斯腾-斯地古姆阈值(k− 1)2=9(k−1)-=2−9为克=4克=4相色相,下方为所植入相色相.
任何适当的取色方法都算得上一个解决方案,不仅仅是被植入的.
我们把图表的相邻矩阵传递到模型中,作为注意的掩体,并从单独的种子流中生成苍蝇上的例子,用于训练、验证(2 048例)和测试(100克)。
硬子集由4,096个图组成的640个顶点,同为正相,边缘概率缩放为0.020.02.

blocks.en:
During training, we augment Sudoku with the symmetries above and Boxoban with joint board and action rotations and reflections, while validation and test examples are unaugmented.
Figure 5 gives the solve rate by difficulty bin and by graph size.

在训练期间,我们用上面的对称和Boxoban来增强数独,并进行联合棋盘和动作旋转和反射,而验证和测试实例则未加识别.
图5按难度本和图大小给出了解析率.

blocks.en: F.6 Language modeling
blocks.zh: F.6 语文建模

blocks.en:
For all text models, we use the diffusion transformer of Sahoo et al. (2024) with time conditioning, with about 92M non-embedding parameters on Text8 and TinyStories and 214M on OpenWebText, and train every run on 131B tokens.
Table 4 lists the remaining training settings.
blocks.zh:
对所有文本模型,我们使用Sahoo等人(2024年)的放行变压器,带有时间调节,在Text8和TinyStories以及OpenWebText上使用约92M非嵌入参数,并在131B令牌上进行每跑一次的训练.
表4列出了其余的培训环境。

blocks.en:
Text8 ( Mahoney, 2011 ) is the first 10 8 10^{8} characters of a cleaned English Wikipedia dump, over 27 characters, in sequences of L = 256 L=256 .
We use the standard split into the first 90M characters for training and 5M each for validation and test.
blocks.zh:
Text8 (Mahoney, 2011)是被清理的英语维基百科垃圾场的前10个8个10^{8}字符,超过27个字符,以L=256 L=256的顺序排列.
我们使用标准分为前90M字符进行训练,5M各用于验证和测试.

blocks.en:
TinyStories ( Eldan & Li, 2023 ) is a corpus of short synthetic stories in simple English.
We tokenize it with our own byte-pair-encoding (BPE) tokenizer of V = 1024 V=1024 tokens, trained on the corpus, and hold one story per sequence of L = 512 L=512 : the story tokens, an EOS token, and PAD tokens up to L L .
We keep the train and validation splits of the released corpus and drop the 3.9% of training and 3.6% of validation stories that do not fit.
This leaves 2,611,361 training stories and 26,637 validation stories, which we split evenly into validation and test sets.
During training, we corrupt and attend to padding like any other token but never score it, so the model does not learn where a story ends.
We therefore sample at a known length: each sample takes the padding positions of a validation story, and these positions follow the forward bridge q s | t , 0 ( ⋅ ∣ Z t i , PAD ) q_{s\mid t,0}(\cdot\mid Z_{t}^{i},\texttt{PAD}) from the prior down to t 1 t_{1} instead of being shown clean, so the model sees them as it did in training.
blocks.zh:
TinyStories (Eldan & Li, 2023)是一套以简单英语为主的短篇合成故事.
我们用我们自己的字节-pair-encoding(BPE)的标注符来标出V = 1024 V = 1024的标注符,经过了官能团的训练,并且每个序列L = 512 L = 512 :故事标语,一个EOS标语,以及PAD标语到L L .
我们保留了释放物的列车和验证分拆 并放弃3.9%的培训 和3.6%的验证故事 不合适。
这留下了2,611,361个训练故事和26,637个验证故事,我们平均分成验证和测试集.
在训练期间,我们贪污腐化,并像其他任何象征物一样去修补,但从未得分,所以模特儿不会知道故事的结局.
因此,我们以已知的长度进行抽样:每个样本都取一个验证故事的粘接位置,这些位置跟随前桥 q s → t, 0 (⋅ → ∣ t i, PAD) q s\ mid t, 0} (\cdot\mid Z_{t}^{i},\textt{ PAD}) 从上下到t 1 t_{1} 而不是被显示为干净,所以模型在训练中看到它们.

blocks.en:
OpenWebText ( Gokaslan & Cohen, 2019 ) is an open reproduction of the WebText corpus.
We tokenize it with our own BPE tokenizer of V = 1024 V=1024 tokens, trained on the corpus, and pack documents into sequences of L = 1024 L=1024 .
We wrap each document in BOS and EOS tokens, follow it with a uniformly random number of 0 to 127 PAD tokens, and cut the resulting stream into consecutive sequences of L L tokens, so a sequence can hold several documents or part of one, and we do not mask attention between documents.
As for TinyStories, we corrupt and attend to padding but never score it, and we exclude it from the likelihoods and the decoded text of App. F.3 .
The corpus has no official split, so we hold out a random 100k documents before packing and split them evenly into validation and test sets, which keeps the three sets document-disjoint.
Like Text8, we sample it unconditionally.
blocks.zh:
OpenWebText (Gokaslan & Cohen, 2019)是一款公开再版的"WebText".
我们用自己的BPE标注符标出 V = 1024 V = 1024 个标注符, 训练有素, 将文件装入 L = 1024 L = 1024 的序列.
我们用 BOS 和 EOS 令牌来包装每个文档,跟随它,统一随机编号为 0到 127 PAD 令牌,并将所生成的流切入L令牌的相接序列,因此一个序列可以持有多个文档或其中一部分,我们不会在文档之间掩盖注意.
至于"小故事",我们腐败了,并注意铺垫,但从未得分,我们排除了App.F.3的概率和解码文本.

blocks.en: Once upon a time, there was a yellow bird. The bird lived in a big tree. The bird had a rag on a high branch. The rag was full of pretty leaves and leaves. The bird liked to play with the rag and the leaves. One day, the bird saw a big, red ball. The bird wanted to play with the ball. But the ball was too big for the bird. The bird was sad and did not want to play with the ball anymore. The bird tried to be brave. It flew down from the tree and got the ball. The bird put the ball on the rag and started to play. Soon, other birds came to play with the yellow bird. They all played together and had fun. The bird was not sad anymore. The bird was happy and made new friends. Once upon a time, there was a mommy and a little girl. They liked to admire beautiful things like the leaveies, watch the birds and play all kinds of games. Today, they decided to create a special use of nature to keep their attention. The mommy pulled out a special bottle from the table. She gave the little girl a glass with water. It was gentle and gentle, and the little girl watched carefully. The little girl looked closely. She watched the birds soar high in the sky and in different ways. It seemed like it was completely so beautiful to fly. The mommy and the little girl watched in amazement. The little girl smiled, and felt so proud. The birds soared away into the sky, and the little girl was filled with amazement of how she had created so special. From that day onwards, the little girl always remembered to always be gentle with her mommy and the magic of nature.
blocks.zh: 昔有黄鸟出. 鸟住大树. 鸟有高枝上布. 满地都是漂亮的叶子 鸟儿喜欢用布和叶子来玩. 一日,鸟见一出大相红球. 这只鸟想玩球 但球对鸟来说太大了 这只鸟很伤心,不想再玩了 这只鸟试图勇敢。 它从树上飞下来,得到了球。 鸟将球放入被子上并开始出场. 不久,有其他鸟来和黄鸟玩. 他们都一起玩 玩得很开心。 这只鸟已经不再伤心了 这只鸟很快乐,结交了新朋友. 从前有个妈妈和一个小女孩 他们喜欢仰慕一些美丽的事物,如"放出","看鸟"等并玩出各种游戏. 今天,他们决定创造一种特殊的自然用途来保持他们的注意力. 妈妈从桌子上取出一瓶特别的酒 她给小女孩倒了杯水 它温柔而温和,小女孩仔细观看. 小女孩仔细看了。 她看着鸟儿在天空和不同的方式飞起 飞起来看起来好美 妈咪和小女孩惊呆地看着 小女孩笑了起来,觉得很骄傲。 鸟儿们飞向了天空, 小女孩充满了惊叹 她是如何创造出如此特殊的。 从那天起,小女孩总是记得对妈妈和大自然的魔法总是温柔.

blocks.en: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. She lived in a small house with her mom, dad, and dog, Poppy. Mia was very excited to play with Poppy. One day, Mia found a piece of paper. She wanted to fold it and make a fun bridge. So, Mia showed the paper to Poppy and said, “Poppy, let’s make a bridge!” Poppy smiled and wagged her tail. Mia and Poppy folded the paper into many shapes like animals and stars. They made a beautiful flower bridge with paper. Mia and Poppy were so excited about their flower bridge. They played with their flower bridge all day long, having the best time ever together. Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue loved to play outside with her friends. One day, Sue and her friends were playing in the mud. They were having a great time, but their clothes and feet got dirty. The clothes were dull and not very nice. “I want to change my game,” said Sue. She went inside her house and got her wet clothes. She left them in the sun to dry them off. But the clothes were still dirty and Sue left the wet clothes outside. The sun was hot and the clothes became wet and dirty. Sue’s mom came to the room and saw the dirty clothes. “You have to change into clean clothes now,” said her mom. Sue was sad because she wanted her clothes to be nice. She went back outside to play with her friends and use clean clothes. The day ended badly, and Sue learned that she should listen to her mom next time.

blocks.en: Once upon a time, there was a grumpy cat named Tom. He lived in a small house with his friend, a little girl named Sue. They liked to play and eat chores. They were very happy together. One day, Sue found a big chain in the yard. She picked it up and showed it to Tom. “Look, Tom! I found a chain!” Sue said. Tom looked at the chain and saw a big door on the other side. It was like a secret door. He liked the chain because it was all by himself! Sue saw Tom looking at the big chain and asked, “What’s wrong, Tom?” Tom said, “I don’t know. It lost my chair.” Sue looked at the chain and saw that it was gone. She said, “Don’t worry, Tom. We will find your chain and eat it together!” So, Tom and Sue looked everywhere for the chair. Finally, they found the chain under the big tree. Tom was so happy! He hugged Sue and said, “Thank you, Sue! You are the best friend ever!” From that day on, Tom wasn’t grumpy anymore. Sue and Tom played together every day, and they always had lots of fun. Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Spot. Spot liked to play and run in the park. One day, Spot saw a big tree. The tree had a tie all around it. Spot was very happy and so big. Spot went up to the tree and asked, “Can I play with you, tree?” The tree nodded and said, “Yes, Spot, you can play today.” Spot was very excited and started to run and jump. After some time, Spot was tired. He sat under the tree and licked his fur. Spot felt very fine and happy. Spot and the tree became good friends. And they played together in the park every day.

blocks.en: Once upon a time, in a small nation, there lived a cute cat named Lily. Lily had a best friend, a dog named Max. Lily and Max were always happy and liked to play together. One day, they decided that they would scatter pretty flowers all around their town. Lily said to Max, “Let’s make our nation beautiful!” Max thought it was a great idea. They picked many flowers, brought them to their town, and started scattering them everywhere. Soon, the nation was full of colorful leaves, flowers, and big trees. Lily and Max were very proud of what they did. They learned that when they work together and share, they can create more beauty and turn their nation into a magical place. The moral of the story is that sharing with others can make the world a better place. Once upon a time, there was a little red car. This car loved to drive fast. One day, the car saw a big, distant hill. The car thought, “I want to go to the top of that hill.” The car tried to go up the hill, but it was too hard. The car was sad. It could not drive up the hill. The car said, “I am sad. I want to go to the top of the hill.” Then, the car saw a big truck. The truck said, “Why are you sad, little car?” The car said, “I can’t go up the big hill.” The truck wanted to help. It pushed the car to the top of the hill. The car was very happy. Now the car could drive down the hill. The car went fast and had fun. The car and the truck became good friends. They drove every day. They had lots of fun together. The end.

blocks.en: neighborhood neighborhoods. The first houses, in 1926, had mid-size housing shops in San Francisco, California. As San Francisco’s population grew, new houses were built. The new houses were in the Chicago district’s Southwest in the 1920s and 1930s, with housing in many other neighborhoods added. blocks.zh: 关于气候变化风险的负面结论,或关于气候变化原因与衡量影响的特定风险因素的合理结论之间的关系的相互矛盾的结论。” 事实上,研究认为,这一证据也支持气候变化本质上是一种长期环境影响的信念,美国航天局等来源的证据表明,全球变暖通过降低温度而得到缓解,而且气候变化有可能使全球气候变化的长期影响大大低于消极而实质性的长期影响。 然而,研究人员认为,全球气候变化的影响可以大大地加以限制,为气候变化的积极影响提供了证据,这并不奇怪。 该研究发表于"自然". 12月,研究人员编写了一份来自环保局的报告,其中表明气候变化的惠益在各地都很明显。 研究表明,这些影响经常发生在许多地区. . 气候变化普遍存在是一个意识形态问题。 研究者还得出结论说,二氧化碳正在造成气候变化的概念“与基本趋势相似”。 研究者们认为,“我以前曾研究过,根据长期的碳排放趋势,使冰盖与二氧化碳和气候变化相呼应,远远超出我想象的,可追溯到1980年代。” 他们包括三位合著者,杰夫·德阿尔特和加州大学伯克利分校和纽约大学的同名作者,加州的布莱恩·博格根和约翰·金,以及百万气候科学的安妮塔·帕内蒂,加州大学伯克利分校,芝加哥大学和唐气候研究中心. 为应对论文所带来的挑战而作的研究于2015年在"北堡"上在网上出现. 关于世界水平与温度之间的关系以及全球变暖的负面影响的所有论点都是虚假的。 论文于2015年1月在"气候变化"杂志上发表. 研究人员对论文进行了审查,并审查了论文,以了解分析是否已经形成。 他们同意其最后结论,并强调指出,该文件是就一个重大环境问题发表的。 他们于2013年审查了该文件,尽管该文件没有产生冲突,并同意选择再次审查。 实验室数据 Monica Mroinsky和Chor Camillo所作的研究受到美国联合统计局研究的启发,该研究试图证明,全球气候变化正在影响长期熨斗影响,包括干旱和环境影响,这些影响对公共卫生具有明显的州和地方影响。 现在有数十万人生活在洛杉矶和洛杉矶南部的大部分地区. 环境影响包括影响大多数郊区居民或洛杉矶县居民总体健康的环境影响。 即使在加利福尼亚州,圣迭戈县的居民也使用天然气,dap油等化学品来影响气候变化的影响. 例如,在纽约市,生物燃料在加利福尼亚州半数居民中排放了超过100%的二氧化碳。 数十万人报告了各种环境影响。 加利福尼亚州环境保护局 法案既承认了洛杉矶部分地区的水污染,也承认了洛杉矶县的环境影响,以及加利福尼亚州的一些速率. 这也与加利福尼亚发生的其他环境影响相一致. 仅在德克萨斯州,就使用一水箱来帮助减少煤炭储备所排放的二氧化碳,这是飓风卡特里娜所看到的一步. 加利福尼亚州拥有核电站正常二氧化碳排放量的69%,由煤电站出产的所有化学物质中有83%用于储存二氧化碳. 三分之一以上来自天然气,大约三分之一来自纽约。 在加利福尼亚,一项新研究即将更新,由加州洛杉矶气候变化候选人和加州大学圣迭戈分校公共关系教授迈克尔·克伊斯(Michael Keays)领导. 洛杉矶县的居民对邻近地区的研究尤其感到沮丧. 在洛杉矶,洛杉矶县公共卫生服务部的前助理美国检察官迈克尔·布朗(Michael Brown)对洛杉矶的环境影响进行了新的研究. 然而,该研究没有披露在受条件影响的郊区或邻里发生的相对伤害程度。 在洛杉矶,研究还显示,加利福尼亚州某些地区最重要的环境影响是在加利福尼亚州以南,而不是在加利福尼亚州以南. 在该国部分地区,环境影响最大的地区可能在全球变暖趋势中起一定作用. 除了对环境影响最大的地区的影响外,最近的城市数据表明,正在研究的许多环境影响可能发生在洛杉矶县的其他地方。 因此,预计在加利福尼亚州部分地区,环境影响将更为广泛地升级。

blocks.zh: 给环境带来更多资源, 无论是这些事情对人民来说都有意义,因为相互竞争的边界是比环境经济更值钱的经济的基本优先事项。 有50多万人失业,在日本有30万人,他们知道自己可以造成各种痛苦。 一家四口人最终无家可归,要让他们脱离产妇护理,这对中产家庭来说是一种无望的好处,也是他们为保护子女和家庭而失去的东西。 但是,履行这一承诺的人将在任何可能的地方有所收获,为他们找到工作,并保护他们的尊严。 不幸的是,没有人认为日本希望开始将自己的福祉同自己的福祉相分离,这样会更好. 这些人对完全混合文化失去了任何兴趣. 日本的小企业认为,独立制造业是造成不安全和为今后两个半世纪的宝贵资源作广告的主要原因。 日本将这一想法应用于农村地区非熟练工人工资更低的地区,以及规模较大的经济体,因为那里劳动力众多,财富从小型经济转移到农村经济的空间有限,还有更大的政治和经济繁荣的前景。 面对政府不断的医疗挑战,东京开始抓住环境主义的社会主义,与汽车工业基本上有爱情关系. 估计90%的日本人口比其他地方更有利可图。 今天,政府对鼓励劳动力流动的廉价和削减成本的商业/福利等的解决方案被证明不适合大企业. 当然,福克拉姆派有多样性,人们并不坚持他们的认可。 同时,市场“财产权”与实际私人权利之间有着显著的区别。 市场体系影响着人们,以这种方式严格对待人们太少,部分原因是人们如此绝望地得不到更大的接受者的保护。 这些风险在社会化的首要价值中显而易见:我们人类是建立在相互力量的基础上,超越了宇宙的种族结构。 部长们感到鼓舞的是,似乎一无所有。 他们表示自己不会威胁人类, 它的长期“文化秩序”将改变人们的生活方式。 他们认为,他们更愿意为自己谋取利益,他们越来越担心,那些无权使用 " 个人和纳税人的土地 " 的人将受到审判。 弗兰肯斯坦夜跑 Boxhorns的故事:A.J.,他为恢复正常生活而艰难地奔跑。 他离开了他哥哥的田地,并轻松地恢复了与幸运克拉克的友谊. 弗兰肯斯坦之夜(英語:Frankenstein Night)是一部关于A.J.以高二为生的电影. A.J.想花钱建立一个团队,并相信他能够在两年内到达那里。 A.J.决定返回泰国并完成赛季. 一开始他很疯狂, 弗兰肯斯坦曾经是历史的一部份, 在赛车时间之后,它最终达到了今天。 奥古斯特·佩里莱斯(英语:August Perriles),1984-1988年最佳跑道运动员. 又一个天才TBP男. 佩里莱斯是历史上最伟大的幻想回路,最终以三重场景打破了2012年日本电影界的心脏. 巨型机器回来很愉快, 刻出拥有一辆车的寿命, 不觉得饿了, 因为最后的钱流出汽车。 他忙着装傻 有辆曾经有钱的车 由于TBP谜语,他想出演一部会破坏"热门运动赛跑"地平线和"回路"精神的电影. 9.
